liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): Reviewer, who attended, ranks the second-set Scarlet into Fire among the best ever; Reviewer finds the Scarlet into Fire jaw-droppingly good [25][29][32]
- **Hey Jude** (1 review, 2 other sources): Brent sings the entire song, stumbling over some words, in a humble, fun version; Brent sang the whole song; the last complete version was 03-01-1969, 1522 shows earlier [1][7][28]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the transition from Scarlet into Fire the best of all time; The Fire is described as one for the ages [26][31]
- **Believe It Or Not** (1 review, 1 other source): Believe It Or Not is named as a highlight; The previous Believe It Or Not was 10-21-1988, 89 shows earlier [1][34]
- **West L.A. Fadeaway** (1 review): West L.A. is named as a highlight, unlike another reviewer's opinion [34]
- **Samson And Delilah** (1 review): Samson is said to rip nicely [32]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Truckin' singled out as outrageously good [34]

## Setlist highlights

- **Believe It Or Not**: rare: 9 archived performances [36]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-03-22.mtx.seamons.113144.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 161 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1990-03-22.156195.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 21 songs; 158 min [4]
- **gd1990-03-22.165885.mtx.seamons.ht090.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 157 min [6]. Said about its sound: Audience tape adds crowd energy and resonance; light static remains between songs, in Space into Other One, and quiet Hey Jude parts [6]
- **gd1990-03-22.152792.3-Source-MTX.photoLeon.t-flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 163 min [7]
- **gd90-03-22.sbd-matrix.aj.453.sbefail.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 151 min; rated 4.32/5 by 25 [16]
- **gd90-03-22.sbd.bertha-ashley.21433.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 151 min; rated 4.34/5 by 50 [22]. Said about its sound: Recording lacks high and low end richness, with an open, roomy sound; reviewer doubts its pedigree; Sound is excellent, close to a soundboard but not quite; Not a pure soundboard; has a deep echo that the reviewer likes [31][32][33]

## Around the show

- Attendee felt at home when the opener started; credits Canada, the border and less smoke [28]
- The uploader and Squeaky snuck onto the floor for the second set [7]
- Reviewer counts this among the best of roughly 50 shows they attended [26]
- First set judged only average compared with other shows of that period [31]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-03-22.mtx.seamons.113144.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: flac16: Matrix by Jubal Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (SHN & FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT) [1]
- **gd1990-03-22.156195.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  March 29, 2022; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-X90) [4]
- **gd1990-03-22.165885.mtx.seamons.ht090.flac16**: source: Matrix by Jubal Hunter Seamons using Soundtrack Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Soundtrack > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) October 2, 2023 [6]
- **gd1990-03-22.152792.3-Source-MTX.photoLeon.t-flac16**: source: Matrix created in Adobe Audition by Joe Noel May 16, 2021 [7]. Also: Three-source matrix: audience tapes by Ray and Ted, Cutler's soundboard, Gans's PCM tapes, transferred by Charlie Miller [7]
- **gd90-03-22.sbd-matrix.aj.453.sbefail.shnf**: source: SBD (Matrix)> DAT> CD> EAC> [retracking of d2 w/ SF, no other alteration]> SHN [16]. Also: Files in this matrix listing are actually from the previous night, 3-21-90, and the tracks carry that show's titles [24]
- **gd90-03-22.sbd.bertha-ashley.21433.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [22]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1990-03-22 Thu Copps Coliseum, Hamilton, Canada](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1251188640243/grateful-dead-1990-03-22-thu-copps) [37]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1990-03-21 Copps Coliseum, Hamilton, Ontario, Canada - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1990-03-21-copps-coliseum-hamilton-ontario-canada/) [38]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Copps Coliseum - March 22, 1990](https://www.dead.net/show/march-22-1990) [39]
- Poster by Dave Goodwich: [30th Anniversary of The Grateful Dead's Spring '90 Tour: Copps Coliseum, Hamilton, Ontario 3/22/90 - Glide Magazine](https://glidemagazine.com/241736/30th-anniversary-of-the-grateful-deads-spring-90-tour-copps-coliseum-hamilton-ontario-3-22-90/) [40]

Reviewer, who attended, ranks the second-set Scarlet into Fire among the best ever
Reviewer calls the transition from Scarlet into Fire the best of all time
Reviewer counts this among the best of roughly 50 shows they attended
Brent sings the entire song, stumbling over some words, in a humble, fun version
Attendee felt at home when the opener started; credits Canada, the border and less smoke
Reviewer finds the Scarlet into Fire jaw-droppingly good
The Fire is described as one for the ages
Recording lacks high and low end richness, with an open, roomy sound; reviewer doubts its pedigree
First set judged only average compared with other shows of that period
Reviewer calls this Scarlet-Fire the best they ever saw live
Samson is said to rip nicely
Sound is excellent, close to a soundboard but not quite
Not a pure soundboard; has a deep echo that the reviewer likes
Truckin' singled out as outrageously good
Believe It Or Not is named as a highlight
West L.A. is named as a highlight, unlike another reviewer's opinion
Brent sang the whole song; the last complete version was 03-01-1969, 1522 shows earlier
The previous Believe It Or Not was 10-21-1988, 89 shows earlier
Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; tape flips were covered by a mobile truck DAT
Audience tape adds crowd energy and resonance; light static remains between songs, in Space into Other One, and quiet Hey Jude parts
Three-source matrix: audience tapes by Ray and Ted, Cutler's soundboard, Gans's PCM tapes, transferred by Charlie Miller
The uploader and Squeaky snuck onto the floor for the second set
